Project.Name: information-protection.xml
Project.Title: Information Protection: Classes, Labels, DLP and Evidence in Microsoft Purview

Task.Name: Phase 0 — Classes, decisions and the audit floor
IP0.1 Class register: CUI categories held (Basic or Specified), Privacy Act records, retention, impact level and cloud, each with its source
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner (CUI program manager) Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/01-data-inventory-and-classification.md#b20-01-the-federal-overlay-decisions

Task.Name: IP0.2 Inventory: where each class already sits, from content and activity explorer under narrowly granted role groups
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/01-data-inventory-and-classification.md#b20-01-inventory-find-where-the-data-already-is

Task.Name: IP0.3 Unified audit on and retained, routed to the log platform; a synthetic audit event found by search within the target time
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/10-audit-insider-risk-and-communication-compliance.md#audit-is-the-floor

Task.Name: D-IP1 Tenant root key for Rights Management
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner, with the CISO Options: Microsoft-managed key; bring your own key (BYOK), per Book 12, Chapter 09. Decided before the first encrypting label is published If decided late: Rights Management can't be activated, and no encrypting label can be published Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/05-rights-management-and-recovery.md#b20-05-decide-activation-onboarding-and-recovery

Task.Name: IPG0 Gate 0 — Classes decided, audit on
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Criteria: Class register with every federal overlay decision and its source; inventory showing where each class sits; unified audit on, retention set and routed to the log platform, with a synthetic event found within the target time; the decision record template in use Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/01-data-inventory-and-classification.md#decision-record-template

Task.Name: Phase 1 — Labels, defaults and Rights Management
IP1.1 Label taxonomy built in a test tenant: classes to labels, scopes, priority, encryption settings, markings, publishing policies
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/02-sensitivity-label-architecture.md#b20-02-how-build-the-taxonomy-in-a-test-tenant

Task.Name: D-IP2 Default labels and mandatory labeling for files, email, meetings and containers
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner Options: A non-encrypting default per item type, with mandatory labeling and a justification for every downgrade; mandatory labeling with no default If decided late: The pilot policy has no defaults, and ring 1 waits Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/03-label-publication-and-defaults.md#b20-03-defaults-the-agency-can-justify

Task.Name: IP1.2 Rights Management activated and staged: onboarding limited to the label pilot; super user feature off; two recovery operators named
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/05-rights-management-and-recovery.md

Task.Name: X-AG1 Privileged Access Gate 1 — Foundation ready (PIM role settings for every tier)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO (Privileged Access & Administrative Identity plan) If decided late: Recovery operators can't be made eligible through PIM, so the super user procedure can't be rehearsed Source: privileged-access.md

Task.Name: IP1.3 Super user recovery rehearsed in the test tenant with PIM-eligible operators; decryption-continuity test passed
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/05-rights-management-and-recovery.md#validate-the-decryption-continuity-test

Task.Name: IP1.4 Ring 1: label policy and pilot defaults for 25 to 50 users, two weeks; label events and downgrade justifications read; labeled sample passes
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/03-label-publication-and-defaults.md#b20-03-validate-a-labeled-sample

Task.Name: IP1.5 Ring 2: one or two offices per CUI program, two weeks; then the production policy for everyone in scope
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/03-label-publication-and-defaults.md#b20-03-enforcement

Task.Name: IPG1 Gate 1 — Labels in use
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Criteria: Label policy widened past ring 2 on its recorded criteria; labeled sample file and email with the label in the audit log; defaults set; users outside the policy recorded; super user off with no standing members, recovery rehearsed and the decryption-continuity test passed Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#implementation-checklist

Task.Name: Phase 2 — Containers, SharePoint and OneDrive, and mail
D-IP4 Label integration for SharePoint and OneDrive, legacy IRM libraries, PDFs and co-authoring
Task.Contact: Policy owner, with the records officer
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner, with the records officer Options: Integration on before the first encrypting label leaves the pilot; PDFs only after Chapter 09's simulations include them; each IRM library migrated, then IRM off (in GCC, kept until its files are labeled); co-authoring only when every tool that reads labels supports it If decided late: Encrypted files in SharePoint can't be searched, co-authored or scanned, and ring 2 waits Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/07-sharepoint-and-onedrive.md

Task.Name: IP2.2 Label integration on for SharePoint and OneDrive, after labels have replicated to the service
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/07-sharepoint-and-onedrive.md

Task.Name: IP2.3 Legacy IRM libraries moved to sensitivity labels one by one, a volunteer library first; IRM turned off on each
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/07-sharepoint-and-onedrive.md

Task.Name: D-IP3 Container classes and who may create Teams, groups and sites
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner Options: A container label per class with its privacy, guest and unmanaged-device settings; creation open to all, or limited to a group, for each class If decided late: Container labels can't be piloted, and the oversharing work Copilot waits for can't start Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/04-teams-groups-and-sharepoint-containers.md#b20-04-who-may-create-containers

Task.Name: X-P16 Conditional Access baseline enforced; emergency access accounts tested (program P1.6)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: Container labels' unmanaged-device setting has no Conditional Access baseline to work with Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: IP2.1 Container labels: pilot sites for two weeks with Conditional Access in report-only, then required for new containers and applied to CUI-bearing sites for two
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/04-teams-groups-and-sharepoint-containers.md#b20-04-enforcement

Task.Name: D-IP5 Approved message-encryption scenarios, and the recipient experience
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner Options: Sender opt-in, named offices, Do Not Forward to a partner, expiring mail where Advanced Message Encryption is licensed; one-time passcodes on or off; social IDs on or off; branding If decided late: Transport rules can't be written, and message encryption waits Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/06-exchange-message-encryption.md

Task.Name: IP2.4 Message encryption verified and branded; each transport rule in Audit for two weeks, enforced for ring 1 for one, then rings 2 and 3
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/06-exchange-message-encryption.md

Task.Name: IPG2 Gate 2 — Containers, libraries and mail protected
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Criteria: Container labels required for new sites and applied to CUI sites, with guest add and unmanaged-device access tested; label integration on and IRM libraries migrated or dated; an encrypted test message opened by an external recipient, with the rule hit in the message trace Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#implementation-checklist

Task.Name: Phase 3 — DLP and auto-labeling
D-IP6 DLP outcomes for each class and surface: block, warn, or allow with justification
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner Options: Outcome statements per class for mail, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive, and Windows devices, each with its exceptions and their expiry If decided late: DLP policies can't be written, and simulation waits Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/08-dlp-and-endpoint-controls.md

Task.Name: IP3.4 Custom sensitive information types written as code; exact data match where the class needs it
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/09-auto-labeling-and-sensitive-information-types.md

Task.Name: IP3.1 Workload DLP in simulation for the pilot across a business cycle; matched items exported before the 30 days are up
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/08-dlp-and-endpoint-controls.md

Task.Name: IP3.2 Workload DLP enforced ring by ring: ring 2 with override and justification, ring 3 everyone in scope; false positives tuned
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/08-dlp-and-endpoint-controls.md

Task.Name: X-P23 Pilot devices moved by pattern (program P2.3)
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform teams (program) If decided late: Endpoint DLP has no managed pilot devices to onboard Source: program-master-schedule.md

Task.Name: IP3.3 Endpoint DLP on Windows: pilot devices onboarded, rules in Audit for two weeks, then enforced ring by ring
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/08-dlp-and-endpoint-controls.md#b20-08-enforcement-endpoint

Task.Name: IP3.5 Service-side auto-labeling in simulation over pilot sites, PDFs in scope; precision recorded; automatic turn-on left off
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/09-auto-labeling-and-sensitive-information-types.md

Task.Name: D-IP7 Move each auto-labeling policy from simulation to labeling
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner Options: Turn the policy on once its false positives are resolved; keep it in simulation If decided late: Existing content stays unlabeled, and PDF support in SharePoint stays off Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/09-auto-labeling-and-sensitive-information-types.md

Task.Name: IP3.6 Auto-labeling policies on; PDF support turned on in SharePoint and OneDrive
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/07-sharepoint-and-onedrive.md

Task.Name: IPG3 Gate 3 — DLP and auto-labeling enforced
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Criteria: Synthetic sensitive content blocked on each surface and the alert received by security operations; every rule exception with an expiry; auto-labeling precision recorded and sample files labeled as designed Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#implementation-checklist

Task.Name: Phase 4 — Insider risk and AI data security
IP4.1 Insider risk charter drafted: purpose and templates, notice and privacy documentation, bargaining obligations, investigator powers, roles, retention
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Senior agency official for privacy Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/10-audit-insider-risk-and-communication-compliance.md#the-charter-comes-first

Task.Name: D-IP8 Adopt the insider risk charter
Task.Contact: CISO, with the senior agency official for privacy and general counsel
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: CISO, with the senior agency official for privacy and general counsel Options: Adopt it, then configure; don't configure Insider Risk Management or Communication Compliance If decided late: Neither tool can be configured, and Gate 4 waits Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/10-audit-insider-risk-and-communication-compliance.md#the-charter-comes-first

Task.Name: IP4.2 Insider Risk Management and Communication Compliance for a pilot scope: a 30-day audit phase, alerts triaged, a tuning record
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Security operations Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/10-audit-insider-risk-and-communication-compliance.md#b20-10-enforcement-irm

Task.Name: D-IP9 AI data decisions: approved AI apps and their data, labels Copilot mustn't process, oversharing remediation, who may read prompts
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Policy owner Options: Per app class (Copilot in the tenant, enterprise AI apps, third-party AI sites): approve for named classes, or block. Prompt and response access settled with the privacy official and counsel If decided late: AI policies can't leave simulation, and Copilot reaches users before oversharing is fixed Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/11-ai-data-security.md#the-ai-data-decisions

Task.Name: IP4.3 Data risk assessment for oversharing read; DSPM and Copilot DLP in simulation for at least two weeks across a month-end
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/11-ai-data-security.md

Task.Name: IP4.4 Copilot DLP enforced; paste to unapproved AI sites blocked; a labeled file cited but not summarized
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Operator Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/11-ai-data-security.md#b20-11-enforcement-ai

Task.Name: IPG4 Gate 4 — Insider risk and AI data governed
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Criteria: Charter adopted before configuration; Insider Risk Management and Communication Compliance on for their scope after the audit phase, with users excluded only by the privacy official's approval; Copilot DLP enforced and AI-site paste blocked; approved AI apps and label exclusions recorded Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#implementation-checklist

Task.Name: Phase 5 — Operations and evidence
IP5.1 Configuration baseline exported and reviewed; drift run scheduled; first drift run with no unexplained differences
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md

Task.Name: IP5.2 Operating cadence written into the day-two runbook; quarterly synthetic tests run once; help desk briefed
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: Platform owner Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#operating-cadence

Task.Name: IP5.3 Assessor's package assembled from the evidence catalog; Zero Trust Assessment rerun
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#evidence-catalog

Task.Name: IPG5 Gate 5 — Operated with evidence
Task.Notes: Owner or approver: ISSO Criteria: Every row of the implementation checklist ticked with the evidence the catalog names; first drift run clean; quarterly synthetic tests passed once; assessor's package assembled (closure is the authorizing official's decision) Source: ../books/b20-information-protection/12-operations-and-evidence.md#evidence-catalog
